title: Yoroll
lede: Yoroll is a no-code editor that turns a script, image or video clip into a playable story, where you direct scenes, place choices and branch the plot toward different endings.

points: Projects start from a premise, script, image or video clip, with no game engine involved.
Creators direct each scene and add player choices that split the storyline into separate outcomes.
AI stitches the scenes into an interactive piece that can be published and shared.
The launch comment points to a playable Odyssey with more than 140 AI-generated scenes and 11 endings.
It comes from the LinearGame team, who showed it at GDC and NVIDIA GTC before launch.

sections.text: Writers of short dramas and AI video makers who already know where an audience could steer the story, but have never built a game.
